speaker: Doctor
text: Let's start by understanding your history: you mentioned significant medical issues in the past. Can you describe what those conditions were and when they were diagnosed?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. To better understand the progression of your ataxia, have you experienced any recent infections, head trauma, or new medications, and did you ever have episodes of confusion or memory loss?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy. The combination of gait/limb ataxia, recent onset of clumsiness, and the use of natalizumab in the context of Crohn's disease is highly suggestive of JC virus reactivation. I will request an MRI of the brain to confirm the findings. REQUEST IMAGES: Brain_MRI
